title: What the Maned Wolf answers to

is_this_you.pressure: Pushed, you rise on those long legs and look over the grass. Then you say one thing, once, and leave it.
is_this_you.love: You can love someone for years and still walk most of the day on your own path. Dusk is when you call.
is_this_you.cost: People keep naming you after animals you are not. Correcting them would mean joining the argument.

opener.text: Guará. In Tupi the word means red [s12]. That was the whole name, a color, given by the people who lived beside it [s12]. The Guarani looked at its size instead and said aguara guasu, the large fox [s2] [s8]. Neither name calls it a wolf [s12]. Strangers have handed you the wrong name for years. The people who live near you just say what they see.

howto: Three parts, any order. Long legs, short reads.

tabs.label: The odd one
tabs.intro: Too tall for a fox. Too fond of fruit for a wolf.

rows.text: Aquarius is fixed Air, the original thinker who keeps thinking it [s14]. Its old shadow is contrariness, and an identity built on being the outsider [s14] [s15]. The Tiger is yang Wood, brave, competitive and unpredictable [s16] [s17]. Set both on stilts and you stand above the grass with the whole field in view. You hold ground nobody else thought to claim, and you hold it calmly.

The maned wolf is the tallest of the wild canids and the only species in its genus [s2]. Its nearest living relative is the bush dog [s2]. Wolf is a guess made from a distance. You gave up explaining your family tree years ago.

tabs.label: Two of you, apart
tabs.love_lead: Maned wolf mates share and defend one territory, then hunt, travel and rest apart for most of the year [s3] [s4]. A deep bark, often heard after dusk, is how a pair keeps track of each other [s3] [s6]. You love like that, loyal for years and gone most afternoons. The right one takes a silent afternoon as just an afternoon. Three old pairings know how to answer your call.

tabs.label: Your ground
tabs.intro: Hold the mountain. Do not get lured off it.

rows.text: Your best work sits in a niche nobody has mapped. Field research, solo strategy and odd small businesses all suit you. Turning down good advice because it is ordinary is Tiger pride talking.

Chinese strategy names the way rivals beat a tiger: 调虎离山 (diào hǔ lí shān), lure the tiger off its mountain [s10]. It means pulling someone out of their stronghold before the fight [s10]. Your bait is usually an argument about what to call you. Stay on your ground and that argument has nowhere to happen.

easy.why: The Cacomistle (Gemini, Pig year) is your secret friend, since the Pig is the Tiger's hidden ally, and Gemini is Air like you [s16] [s17].
The Flamingo (Libra, Horse year) shares your trine of Tiger, Horse and Dog, and Libra is the third Air sign [s16] [s14].
The Albatross (Sagittarius, Horse year) is trine kin, and Sagittarius Fire with Aquarius Air is the old complementary pairing [s16] [s14].

hard.why: The hard one is the Regal Jumping Spider (Leo, Monkey year): the Monkey clashes with the Tiger, and Leo sits opposite Aquarius [s16] [s14].

story.text: Brazil put the maned wolf on its R$200 note in 2020, the highest note the country issues [s2] [s13]. People carry it folded in their wallets, which is about as close to a luck charm as a banknote gets. Chinese has a proverb the animal seems to live by: 一山不容二虎 (yī shān bù róng èr hǔ), one mountain cannot hold two tigers [s9].

closing: You never needed the right name. You needed your own ground, and someone who answers at dusk.
